# Pinnacle proxy: distance to Pinnacle's own close (generated by odds_proxy.py)

KL = KL(Pinnacle || candidate), mLL: the log loss the candidate gives away if Pinnacle's chance were the truth (lower = nearer Pinnacle). "− BetOnline": the paired KL difference, + = the candidate further from Pinnacle than BetOnline. Reads no result.
